## Message

```
[X18N5002] More than one review store <detail>
├▶ fix: Name the store to use in `review.store`.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n5002
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

Plugins add more than one review store, and only one can be active.

1. Run `x18n doctor` to see the plugins.
2. Set `review.store` to the id of the store to use.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
